posts.title: Bumper BI adds VIN-level attribution across departments
posts.author: Vicimus Team
posts.excerpt: Sales, service, parts, and inventory reporting now share a single connected layer — with benchmarked KPIs and trend analysis.
posts.body:
Bumper BI now ties every metric back to the VIN, giving dealership leadership one connected view across sales, service, parts, and inventory.

## Why VIN-level matters

Most dealership reporting lives in silos. Sales sees one dashboard, service another, and parts a third — with no shared thread between them. VIN-level attribution changes that by making the vehicle the common key across every department.

- Compare department performance in context, not isolation
- Spot inventory aging and fixed-coverage issues before they hit profitability
- Track revenue per VIN across the full ownership lifecycle

## What it means for your store

Leadership teams can finally have one trusted conversation about performance, backed by numbers everyone agrees on. That's the whole point of business intelligence — **fewer arguments about the data, more decisions made on it.**

posts.title: Why white-glove support still matters in 2026
posts.author: Vicimus Team
posts.excerpt: As automotive vendor support dwindles industry-wide, our dedicated performance model is more relevant than ever.
posts.body:
Across the industry, vendor support is thinning out. Layoffs and downsizing have left many dealers on their own after the sale.

We built Vicimus around the opposite idea. Every account gets a dedicated performance manager, and we **cap the number of active clients per team member** so that attention is real, not theoretical.

## The monthly strategy session

Every client meets with their performance manager on a regular cadence to review results, align on goals, and prioritize what's next. It's the difference between a tool you're handed and a partner who owns the outcome with you.

posts.title: Intent mining: reaching customers before they shop
posts.author: Vicimus Team
posts.excerpt: How capturing behavioral signals lets your store engage at the forefront of the customer's consideration process.
posts.body:
What if you could identify who was most likely to become a lead before they started shopping?

That's the idea behind intent mining. By sorting, filtering, and analyzing your existing customer data, we surface the signals that indicate a customer is moving toward a purchase or service decision — and get your store in front of them first.

## Ahead of the third parties

The alternative is waiting until that customer shows up on a third-party lead provider's list, at which point you're paying to reach someone who was already yours. Intent mining keeps the relationship — and the margin — where it belongs.
